mentions.name: golem-forge
mentions.description: An exploration of prompting as programming, entirely vibe-coded with LLMs even though the author doesn't know TypeScript. The project has grown to about 27k lines of code and demonstrates how LLMs make it feasible to borrow parts of open-source libraries rather than only building on top of them.
